en: The postcard image shows an old European street or lane, bordered by trees, with a large, imposing set of buildings in the background. To the right is a tall, pointed church spire, while another building with a dome appears further back. In the foreground, several cows are grazing near a wall, and a few people dressed in historic clothing are walking. The scene looks pastoral and serene, likely representing a town with a significant religious or educational landmark.
